# Kestwick Relays - relay-api configuration

`relay-api` terminates and forwards authenticated webhooks for customer platforms.

Two config layers apply: config/relay-settings.json is the production instance config and config/relay-defaults.json is the platform defaults. A key set in the instance config wins; any key the instance config does not set falls back to the defaults. A key in neither layer has no value at all.

turns.prompt: Kestwick Relays is drafting the compliance note for relay-api and needs two effective settings: audit_log_retention_days and session_absolute_timeout_min. What are they?
